- Success metric: 40% reduction in average token cost and sub-500ms tail latency for 95th pct

Next step: technical deep dive / demo where we walk through a sample integration, performance expectations, and a mutual action plan. Proposed times (all PT):
- Wed 2027-03-31 9:00-10:00am
- Wed 2027-03-31 1:00-2:00pm

Please confirm which slot works and who from your team will join (dev/infra, product, security). I've attached a short demo agenda and a draft mutual action plan to help align outcomes.

If you want this to be more of a security/ops deep dive, we can loop in Rafael (cc'd) from our solutions engineering team.
